# fct_portal_sessions

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_portal_sessions` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table of Advisor Portal sessions reconstructed from Segment's multi-event structure. Sessions can include multiple page views. Each row is a unique session (defined as starting when a user lands on the site and continues until 30 minutes of inactivity) plus metrics such as conversions, engagement, and view counts. NOTE Segment does not track 100% of sessions -- users can opt out of analytics tracking. Sourced from Segment.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `session_id` | Primary Key. Unique ID assigned to each session using the user_id and session_id. >> SOURCE - Segment data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `blended_user_id` | Foreign Key. The identifier used for sessionization - uses anonymous_id when user_id is 0, otherwise uses user_id. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `has_partners_page_view` | True / False indicating if a session had a page view in the Portal Booking Platform (i.e. page_path_level_1 was equal to /partners). >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `landing_page_context_user_ip_address` | The user's IP Address. Since the IP address can change during a session, we use the first one recorded. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `landing_page_query_string` | The session's landing page query string (after the '?') in the URL from the first event of the page view. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `landing_page_subdomain` | The session's landing page's domain. Examples include advisor or trips. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `landing_page_title` | The title of the session's landing page; comes from the <title> in the HTML from the first event of the page view. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `landing_page_url` | The session's landing page destination + query string of URL from the first event of the page view. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `landing_page_path` | The destination path of the URL, such as '/partners/hotels'. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `landing_page_path_level_1` | Only the first level of the path (right after the first slash). >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `landing_page_path_level_2` | Only the second level of the path (right after the second slash). >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `landing_page_path_level_3` | Only the third level of the path (right after the third slash). >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `landing_page_path_level_4` | Only the fourth level of the path (right after the fourth slash). >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `landing_page_referrer` | The URL of the page that brought the user to the website or app. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_view_count` | The number of page views that occur within a session. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `session_at` | Timestamp of when the session began. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `session_engagement_time_sec` | The duration of the session, calculated by the difference in first and last event timestamps. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `session_sequence` | The session number (such as first, second, third, etc.) for a User. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `user_id` | Foreign Key. The 'User ID' in the Portal database. >> SOURCE - Segment |
